cards.term: Change into indirect speech: He said, "What a clever idea!"
cards.definition:
Indirect: He exclaimed with admiration that it was a very clever idea.

Rule: What a becomes very.

Memory hook: What a clever becomes very clever.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: She said, "How beautifully he sings!"
cards.definition:
Indirect: She exclaimed with admiration that he sang very beautifully.

Rule: Exclamation changes to a statement with very.

Memory hook: How beautifully becomes very beautifully.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: He said, "May India prosper!"
cards.definition:
Indirect: He prayed that India might prosper.

Rule: May in a prayer changes to prayed that + might.

Memory hook: May in prayer becomes might.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: The old woman said to the boy, "May you be happy!"
cards.definition:
Indirect: The old woman blessed the boy that he might be happy.

Rule: Blessing with may changes to blessed + object + that + might.

Memory hook: Blessings use might in indirect speech.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: He said to me, "May you never suffer!"
cards.definition:
Indirect: He blessed me that I might never suffer.

Rule: May you in blessing becomes blessed + object + that + might.

Memory hook: The blessing remains kind, the modal becomes might.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: She said, "May the truth come out!"
cards.definition:
Indirect: She prayed that the truth might come out.

Rule: Prayer with may becomes prayed that + might.

Memory hook: May becomes might in prayer.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: He said to his rival, "May you lose!"
cards.definition:
Indirect: He cursed his rival that he might lose.

Rule: Negative wish with may can be reported as cursed.

Memory hook: Bad blessings are curses.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: The teacher said, "Silence, please."
cards.definition:
Indirect: The teacher requested the class to be silent.

Rule: Short commands can be expanded in indirect speech.

Memory hook: Silence becomes requested to be silent.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: The officer said, "Attention!"
cards.definition:
Indirect: The officer ordered the soldiers to stand at attention.

Rule: One-word commands are reported by meaning.

Memory hook: Meaning matters more than literal words.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: The judge said, "Order! Order!"
cards.definition:
Indirect: The judge called for order.

Rule: Repeated courtroom command can be reported as called for order.

Memory hook: Not every direct speech line needs a that-clause.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: He said, "What nonsense!"
cards.definition:
Indirect: He exclaimed with anger that it was nonsense.

Rule: Exclamatory fragments are reported by meaning.

Memory hook: Nonsense becomes an angry statement.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: She said, "What a pity!"
cards.definition:
Indirect: She exclaimed with sorrow that it was a great pity.

Rule: What a pity expresses sorrow.

Memory hook: Pity becomes sorrow.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: He said, "How kind of you!"
cards.definition:
Indirect: He thanked me for my kindness.

Rule: Exclamation of gratitude can become thanked.

Memory hook: How kind becomes thanked.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: She said, "How careless of me!"
cards.definition:
Indirect: She blamed herself for being careless.

Rule: Self-critical exclamations can be reported by meaning.

Memory hook: Carelessness becomes self-blame.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: He said, "I am delighted to meet you."
cards.definition:
Indirect: He said that he was delighted to meet me.

Rule: Am becomes was, and you changes to me.

Memory hook: Delight also backshifts.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: She said, "I am looking forward to the trip."
cards.definition:
Indirect: She said that she was looking forward to the trip.

Rule: Present continuous changes to past continuous.

Memory hook: Looking forward becomes was looking forward.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: He said, "I have been trying to call you."
cards.definition:
Indirect: He said that he had been trying to call me.

Rule: Present perfect continuous changes to past perfect continuous.

Memory hook: Have been trying becomes had been trying.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: She said, "I had been waiting before you arrived."
cards.definition:
Indirect: She said that she had been waiting before I arrived.

Rule: Past perfect continuous generally remains unchanged.

Memory hook: Had been waiting is already back enough.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: He said, "I will not be able to attend."
cards.definition:
Indirect: He said that he would not be able to attend.

Rule: Will not be able changes to would not be able.

Memory hook: Will be able becomes would be able.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: She said, "I am able to solve it."
cards.definition:
Indirect: She said that she was able to solve it.

Rule: Am able changes to was able.

Memory hook: Ability backshifts through the be-verb.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: He said, "I was able to escape."
cards.definition:
Indirect: He said that he had been able to escape.

Rule: Was able may change to had been able in full backshift.

Memory hook: Was able becomes had been able.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: They said, "We are unable to pay the fee."
cards.definition:
Indirect: They said that they were unable to pay the fee.

Rule: Are unable changes to were unable.

Memory hook: Unable stays, are becomes were.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: She said, "I have got a new job."
cards.definition:
Indirect: She said that she had got a new job.

Rule: Have got changes to had got.

Memory hook: Have got becomes had got.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: He said, "I get up early."
cards.definition:
Indirect: He said that he got up early.

Rule: Simple present changes to simple past.

Memory hook: Get becomes got.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: She said, "I got up late today."
cards.definition:
Indirect: She said that she had got up late that day.

Rule: Simple past changes to past perfect, today becomes that day.

Memory hook: Got becomes had got.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: He said, "I don't usually eat sweets."
cards.definition:
Indirect: He said that he did not usually eat sweets.

Rule: Do not changes to did not.

Memory hook: Usually stays in place, do becomes did.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: She said, "I rarely watch TV."
cards.definition:
Indirect: She said that she rarely watched TV.

Rule: Simple present changes to simple past.

Memory hook: Rarely does not block tense change.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: He said, "I always carry an umbrella."
cards.definition:
Indirect: He said that he always carried an umbrella.

Rule: Simple present changes to past simple.

Memory hook: Always stays, carry becomes carried.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: She said, "I never tell lies."
cards.definition:
Indirect: She said that she never told lies.

Rule: Present simple changes to past simple.

Memory hook: Never stays, tell becomes told.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: He said, "I have never told a lie."
cards.definition:
Indirect: He said that he had never told a lie.

Rule: Present perfect changes to past perfect.

Memory hook: Have told becomes had told.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: The teacher said, "Do as I say, not as I do."
cards.definition:
Indirect: The teacher advised the students to do as he said, not as he did.

Rule: Imperative/proverb-like advice can be reported with advised.

Memory hook: Say becomes said, do becomes did.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: He said, "Let bygones be bygones."
cards.definition:
Indirect: He suggested that past quarrels should be forgotten.

Rule: Idiomatic suggestions may be reported by meaning.

Memory hook: Meaning beats literal conversion for idioms.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: She said, "Mind the gap."
cards.definition:
Indirect: She warned the passengers to mind the gap.

Rule: Warning commands use warned + object + to.

Memory hook: Public warnings become warned to.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: The notice said, "No smoking."
cards.definition:
Indirect: The notice prohibited smoking.

Rule: Short prohibitions can be reported by meaning.

Memory hook: No smoking becomes prohibited smoking.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: The board said, "Trespassers will be prosecuted."
cards.definition:
Indirect: The board warned that trespassers would be prosecuted.

Rule: Will changes to would in reported warning.

Memory hook: Warning boards are indirect speech gold.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: He said, "I am not feeling well."
cards.definition:
Indirect: He said that he was not feeling well.

Rule: Present continuous changes to past continuous.

Memory hook: Feeling unwell also follows grammar.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: She said, "I feel better now."
cards.definition:
Indirect: She said that she felt better then.

Rule: Present simple changes to past simple, now to then.

Memory hook: Now becomes then.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: He said, "The tea tastes bitter."
cards.definition:
Indirect: He said that the tea tasted bitter.

Rule: Present simple changes to past simple.

Memory hook: Taste backshifts, bitterness remains.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: She said, "The flowers smell sweet."
cards.definition:
Indirect: She said that the flowers smelled sweet.

Rule: Present simple changes to past simple.

Memory hook: Smell becomes smelled.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: He said, "This bag belongs to me."
cards.definition:
Indirect: He said that that bag belonged to him.

Rule: This changes to that, belongs to belonged, me to him.

Memory hook: Belong becomes belonged.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: She said, "This dress fits me."
cards.definition:
Indirect: She said that that dress fitted her.

Rule: This changes to that, fits can become fitted.

Memory hook: Fits becomes fitted in formal backshift.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: He said, "I owe you fifty rupees."
cards.definition:
Indirect: He said that he owed me fifty rupees.

Rule: Owe changes to owed, you changes to me.

Memory hook: Debt survives grammar.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: She said, "I remember this street."
cards.definition:
Indirect: She said that she remembered that street.

Rule: Remember changes to remembered, this to that.

Memory hook: This street becomes that street.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: He said, "I forget names easily."
cards.definition:
Indirect: He said that he forgot names easily.

Rule: Present simple changes to past simple.

Memory hook: Forget becomes forgot, ironically memorable.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: She said, "I understand your concern."
cards.definition:
Indirect: She said that she understood my concern.

Rule: Understand changes to understood, your to my.

Memory hook: Understanding changes pronoun politely.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: He said, "I think you are right."
cards.definition:
Indirect: He said that he thought I was right.

Rule: Think becomes thought, you becomes I, are becomes was.

Memory hook: You are right becomes I was right.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: She said, "I suppose he is busy."
cards.definition:
Indirect: She said that she supposed he was busy.

Rule: Suppose changes to supposed, is to was.

Memory hook: Suppositions also backshift.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: He said, "I expect she will agree."
cards.definition:
Indirect: He said that he expected she would agree.

Rule: Expect changes to expected, will to would.

Memory hook: Expected pulls will to would.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: She said, "I promise I will not be late."
cards.definition:
Indirect: She promised that she would not be late.

Rule: Promise can be reporting verb, will not changes to would not.

Memory hook: Promises sound cleaner without “said that.”

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: He said, "I threaten to resign."
cards.definition:
Indirect: He threatened to resign.

Rule: Threaten is followed by to-infinitive.

Memory hook: I threaten becomes he threatened.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: She said, "I offer to help you."
cards.definition:
Indirect: She offered to help me.

Rule: Offer is followed by to-infinitive.

Memory hook: Offer to help stays compact.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: He said, "I refuse to answer."
cards.definition:
Indirect: He refused to answer.

Rule: Refuse is followed by to-infinitive.

Memory hook: Refuse to answer is direct and clean.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: She said, "I advise you to study daily."
cards.definition:
Indirect: She advised me to study daily.

Rule: Advise takes object + to-infinitive.

Memory hook: Advice becomes advised.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: He said, "I warn you not to trust him."
cards.definition:
Indirect: He warned me not to trust him.

Rule: Warn takes object + not to + V1.

Memory hook: Warning keeps not to.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: She said, "I request you to wait."
cards.definition:
Indirect: She requested me to wait.

Rule: Request takes object + to-infinitive.

Memory hook: Request remains request.

cards.term: Change into indirect speech: He said, "I beg you to forgive me."
cards.definition:
Indirect: He begged me to forgive him.

Rule: Beg takes object + to-infinitive.

Memory hook: Begging changes pronouns, not emotion.
